Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

result.description:
Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Global Enterprising Pty Ltd T/A Solar 4 Life

Date Posted: 28 July 2026

Position: Contract Administrator

Salary: $79,000 - $90,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-time

Location: Unit 4, 66 Heffernan Street, Mitchell ACT 2911

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience as a Contract Administrator or in a similar contract/project administration role

About Us

Global Enterprising Pty Ltd T/A Solar 4 Life is a trusted Australian provider of residential and commercial solar energy solutions. We specialise in the design, supply, and installation of high-quality solar panel systems, battery storage solutions, EV chargers, and energy-efficient technologies. Our team is committed to delivering reliable renewable energy solutions while maintaining exceptional customer service, regulatory compliance, and project excellence. As our operations continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to support the effective administration and coordination of our installation and project contracts.

Key Responsibilities

•	Prepare, review, and administer contracts for residential and commercial solar installation projects.

•	Coordinate contract documentation, approvals, variations, and project records to ensure accuracy and compliance.

•	Monitor contractual milestones, deliverables, and key deadlines throughout project lifecycles.

•	Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal project teams to facilitate smooth project delivery.

•	Assess and process contract variations, extensions of time, and supporting documentation where required.

•	Maintain accurate records of correspondence, project documentation, invoices, and contractual agreements.

•	Assist with procurement activities, including supplier engagement and subcontractor documentation.

•	Support project managers by monitoring contract performance and identifying potential contractual risks or issues.

•	Prepare reports relating to contract status, project progress, budgets, and contractual compliance.

•	Resolve contract-related enquiries and assist in negotiating practical solutions to project issues.

•	Ensure all contract administration activities comply with relevant legislation, company policies, and industry standards.

•	Provide administrative support during project handover and contract close-out processes.

•	Contribute to the continuous improvement of contract administration procedures and documentation systems.

Qualifications

•	Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Commerce, Management, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

•	Minimum 1 year experience as a Contract Administrator or in a similar contract/project administration role.

Skills & Experience

•	Strong understanding of contract administration processes within construction, electrical, renewable energy, or related industries.

•	Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.

•	Ability to build positive working relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

•	Ability to interpret contractual documentation and identify potential risks or discrepancies.

•	Understanding of Australian workplace health and safety requirements and relevant industry regulations.

If you are a motivated Contract Administrator looking to build your career with a respected renewable energy company, we encourage you to apply.

Interested applicant may submit their resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted
